repo.description:
### Impact

An authenticated user listed as a requester in a workflow can set another user’s file into the “pending approval” without access to the file by using the numeric file id. 

### Patches

It is recommended that Nextcloud Approval is upgraded to 2.5.0.

### Workarounds

* Disable the Approval app

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3338748)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/approval/pull/334)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Approval app allows users to request approval for other users file
